review_evidence: README identifies LeanToolkit as a prototype implementation for the paper “Modular Composition of Inductive Types Using Lean Meta-programming,” and the 23 formal-source files were inspected by declaration inventory.

CaseStudy/Boolean.lean, CaseStudy/Nat.lean, CaseStudy/STLC.lean, and CaseStudy/K3.lean define formal syntax/value/relation structures and prove results such as notEmpty and positiveSize for the composed inductive types.

LeanToolkit/Common.lean, Coe.lean, FnSum.lean, Subtype.lean, and TypeSum.lean expose reusable dependent-type/metaprogramming interfaces used by those formal case studies; the mixed source cannot be losslessly reduced to ordinary tooling by an exact selector.
summary: Retain LeanToolkit: the metaprogramming framework is accompanied by substantive dependent-type case studies and theorem-bearing examples of modular inductive-type composition.
